name: Toratsugumi no Komoriuta ~Shiroki Tsuioku~
original_name: 虎鶫の子守唄～白キ追憶～
source:
A rumor of a red-eyed ghost appearing in the haunted house on the hill
was spreading throughout the school.
Aoi is egged-on to follow Mia and her classmates to enter the haunted house...

People keep dying one by one in the mansion---
Is this all an accident? Or is it...

What is the meaning of the dreams she sees when she faints?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE248496.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
学校里流传着一个传言：山丘上的鬼屋会出现红眼幽灵。
葵被鼓动跟随美亚和同学们进入鬼屋……

宅邸里的人一个接一个死去——
这全是意外吗？还是……

她昏倒时看到的梦究竟意味着什么？

[来源：[url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE248496.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
